# from alisa

> 主页

This is the llms.txt file for from alisa. It provides a machine-readable directory of published articles and core pages for Large Language Models.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://alisa22580.com/): Main blog entrance and latest post stream.
- [About](https://alisa22580.com/about/): Author profile, technical stack, and background.
- [Archive](https://alisa22580.com/archive/): Chronological index of all published writings.
